quiz.access.q: Do people only have the access their role requires, reviewed regularly?
quiz.backup.o1: We back up but rarely test
quiz.backup.q: Are backups encrypted, isolated and restore-tested?
quiz.compliance.q: Can you show audit-ready evidence for the standards that apply to you?
quiz.discussMsg: I took the cloud security check and scored {score}/{max} ({level}).
quiz.great: Great posture. Keep it current with regular reviews.
quiz.ir.q: Do you have a documented, practised incident response plan?
quiz.keep: I would like to talk about keeping our security posture current.
quiz.mfa.q: Is multi-factor authentication required for all users and admins?
quiz.monitor.q: Is your cloud monitored for suspicious activity around the clock?
quiz.scored: You scored {score} out of {max}. This is an informal self-assessment, not a security audit.
quiz.tip.access: Apply least-privilege access and review permissions at least quarterly.
quiz.tip.backup: Keep backups isolated from production credentials and test restores on a schedule.
quiz.tip.compliance: Map controls to owners and automate evidence capture so audits are routine.
quiz.tip.ir: Write a short incident plan (who decides, acts, communicates) and rehearse it.
quiz.tip.mfa: Enforce MFA for every user and admin account first. It blocks most credential-based attacks.
quiz.tip.monitor: Add continuous monitoring so risky behavior is flagged outside business hours too.
